run_preprocess_race: run the preprocess_RACE script to extract paragraphs and QA pairs from a RACE dataset directory
run_get_examples: run get_examples to extract paragraph and question-answer lists from RACE JSON files in a given directory
review_InputExample: review the InputExample class that stores a paragraph, question-answer list, and label for RACE data
refactor_get_examples: refactor get_examples to support additional RACE dataset levels or custom JSON field mappings
test_main: test the main function to verify RACE dataset preprocessing outputs correct input and label files
